Point layer of bus stops of the Régie de transport en public de Shawinigan (RTCS) on the territory of the city of Shawinigan.

[Link to the complete Isogeo sheet] (https://open.isogeo.com/s/b6da64af30234cbda2afed3972a5fc3e/Urd8YxfJdWSzGaUmhHFMY60vx14s0/r/49098b82915f46389fe6b14424513da5?lock)

! [RTCS logo] (https://jmap.shawinigan.ca/doc/photos/RTCS-Copie.jpg)



**Collection method**

Location at the corresponding address

**Attributes**

* `objectid` (`integer`): 

* `direction` (`char`): Direction

* `shuttle` (`char`): Shuttle

* `hcar_a` (`char`): Express A

* `hcar_b` (`char`): Express B

* `hcar_n` (`char`): Shuttle 1

* `h_nw` (`char`): Shuttle 2

* `address` (`char`): Address

* `sequence_a` (`integer`): ID Stop

* `shelter` (`char`): Bus shelter

* `mob_reduit` (`char`): Access to reduced mobility

* `latitude` (`double`): Latitude

* `longitude` (`double`): Longitude

* `notes` (`char`): Notes
